answer: A vault of graded work is the only identity that settles. Each pass adds one strut to a trellis of attested epochs; peer minutes refuse any leaf whose parent strut is missing. A plume of fresh keys therefore buys nothing until it rents the same scarce grader inventory the honest schedule already consumed. Clone cost scales with epoch depth, not with signup count, so the hundredth sockpuppet prices itself out before the first payout.
